name: rename_project
description: Rename a KiCAD project: renames the .kicad_pro/.kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb/.kicad_prl files and rewrites the internal references that carry the old name. Renaming the files alone is NOT enough — every symbol instance stores (project "name"), and a mismatch there makes KiCAD treat the design as unannotated, losing every reference designator. Equivalent to eeschema's File > Save As. Use dry_run first.

dry_run.description: Report the planned changes without touching anything. Default false.

rename_directory.description: Also rename the containing folder when it matches the old project name. Default false.
